text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Prime Minister Hamed karoui opens annual meeting of governors to discuss development process in different regions of the country.
- Parliament pursues the debate on the ninth development plan 1997-2001. Deputies discuss its financing and the need to attract foreign investors.
- Great consideration to Tunisia from Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) for Tunisian efforts to develop agricultural sector.
- Tourist nights in the eastern resort of Sousse rose by 15.4 percent during the first six months of 1997 to 1.58 million compared with the same period of 1996.
